title: Noor and the Hollow
premise: Noor Ishikawa's gift for hearing the dead through the bone she carves has kept her alive and invisible in the smuggler's warrens of Thornfell—until the crown's new Witch-Hunt turns every gifted soul into prey. Hunted by a zealous inquisitor and guided by the ghost of her grandmother, Noor discovers her gift is one half of an ancient covenant binding the living realm to the Hollow, the land of the dead, and that the crown's purge is deliberately starving the Hollow to seize its power. To end the hunt, Noor must cross into the Hollow, reforge the broken covenant at the cost of her own lifespan, and expose the crown's lie—but the price of survival may be the very gift she was born with. In the end she chooses justice outside the law, shattering the covenant's exclusivity so the dead speak freely, and returns mortal-eared but free, while the inquisitor faces a tribunal of the living and the dead alike.
about_author: Odile Kavanagh is a former mortuary archivist who spent a decade cataloguing unclaimed remains before turning to fiction, a past that haunts every page of her work. She writes from a croft in the northern highlands, where she claims the wind still carries conversations she refuses to repeat.

chapters.title: What the Bone Remembers
chapters.summary: Noor carves a keepsake for a grieving widow and hears the dead man's last words—a warning about crown riders in the passes. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: the quiet loneliness of a gift she hides, and the first chill of coming danger.

chapters.title: The Edict of Ash
chapters.summary: The crown's proclamation reaches Thornfell: all who hear the dead must surrender for 'cleansing.' Noor's smuggler clients turn fearful; her mentor Tam is seized in a midnight raid. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: the collapse of the fragile community that shielded her, and guilt at surviving.

chapters.title: Grandmother's Knucklebone
chapters.summary: Fleeing through a hidden pass, Noor is found by the ghost of her grandmother, who reveals the Ishikawa line were covenant-keepers between realms—and that the Hollow is starving. POV: Noor, with the grandmother's interjections. Emotional beat: inheritance as burden; grief sharpened into purpose.

chapters.title: The Inquisitor's Ledger
chapters.summary: Inquisitor Serane Voss, who burned her own gifted sister, interrogates Tam and traces Noor's carvings. POV: Voss. Emotional beat: chilling conviction—Voss believes she is merciful, and the reader almost understands her.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Mercy
chapters.summary: Noor bargains with the smuggler queen Yara for passage to the Hollow-gate, paying with a bone carved from her own hand that lets Yara speak once to her dead son. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: the price of survival made literal; an alliance sealed in grief.

chapters.title: The Gate of Teeth
chapters.summary: Noor and Yara's crew fight through the collapsing gate as Voss's riders close in; Tam dies holding the pass, his ghost joining Noor's growing chorus. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: fury and sacrifice—the cost of every step forward.

chapters.title: The Hollow
chapters.summary: Inside the land of the dead, Noor walks a grey echo of Thornfell where the starving dead cling to her warmth, and the Hollow's warden reveals the crown has been harvesting the covenant's power to fuel the hunt itself. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: awe curdling into righteous anger at a systemic injustice.

chapters.title: Voss Descends
chapters.summary: Voss breaches the Hollow seeking final proof the dead are 'unclean,' and meets her sister's ghost. POV: Voss. Emotional beat: her certainty cracks; the first fissure in her righteous armor, though she refuses to name it mercy.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: At the covenant-stone, Noor learns reforging demands her gift—her connection to every voice she loves—as payment. She forges the covenant open instead of closed, letting the dead speak to all, and Voss, hearing her sister forgive her, turns her testimony against the crown. POV: Noor and Voss alternating. Emotional beat: climax—justice outside the law, purchased with the thing she most treasured.

chapters.title: Silence, and the Living
chapters.summary: Noor wakes mortal-eared in Thornfell, where the dead now speak freely and the crown's edict collapses under public testimony—including Voss's. She carves one last bone she cannot hear, and leaves it at Tam's grave. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution—loss accepted, inheritance transformed into something shared.
